title: docs/renode-workflow.md: from-source build never puts renode on PATH; Verify step fails for that path
description: Correctness review finding (gvbc round): the Building from Source section (docs/renode-workflow.md:49-54) leaves the binary at output/bin/Release/renode with no PATH instruction, but the following Verify Installation step (line 59) runs bare 'renode --version' — fails for source builds. Also from-source builds may report a suffixed version string (e.g. 1.16.1.<build>), which would not exactly match the new 'Expected: Renode, version 1.16.1' line. Fix: instruct source builders to invoke output/bin/Release/renode --version (or export PATH) and soften the expectation for source builds. Discovered from gvbc.
close_reason: Fixed the from-source guidance in docs/renode-workflow.md: (1) replaced the stale 'Binary at output/bin/Release/Renode.exe (mono) or renode (Linux)' line — verified against upstream renode/renode (shallow-cloned to ~/GIT/renode per source-of-truth policy): the entry point is the repo-root ./renode bash wrapper execing dotnet on the built Renode.dll under output/bin; mono is not the runtime. (2) Added the note that source builds do NOT install renode on PATH — invoke ./renode from the clone root or symlink it. (3) Verify section now says from-source builds report a similar versioned string via ./renode (previously pointed at nonexistent output/bin/Release/renode, which would fail with 'no such file'). Review: security PASS (kimi-k3); edge-cases found both real defects (nonexistent path, stale mono) — both fixed; correctness retry timed out but its scope (factual accuracy vs upstream, internal consistency, stale refs) was fully covered by the post-fix re-review pass: all claims verified, zero remaining mono/Renode.exe/output-bin-Release matches, no conflicts with apt/nightly or CI portable-tarball flows. Upstream facts double-checked by reviewer independently.
